QuestInfo.name: Goddess Teardrop
QuestInfo.0: Once they had analyzed the situation, Alpha and Beta agreed that #p2420000# truly was the Goddess Teardrop. Hopefully he can explain how that is possible.
QuestInfo.1: The duo questioned #p2420000#, hoping to find out why the Goddess Teardrop was a human, and not a jewel.
QuestInfo.2: #p2420000# told them that time and space were out of line in this world, especially in places like #m322000000#. Though the Goddess Teardrops had only been missing for a short time in their world, #p2420000# had spent decades in this one, growing into the being he had become.

1.0: So, our Goddess Teardrop turned out to be a great ruler! What a strange turn of events this has been. It's impossible to know which of our worlds caused the transformation, but the Goddess's powers must have life of their own.
1.1: To think that Shah Mar has lived a lifetime in another world, when only days have passed in ours...
1.2: That Goddess Teardrop lived, and grew, and waited for the two of you to bring it back to its proper place. I wonder if the other teardrops are doing the same...
